decided: A saved brief is a plain text file holding exactly what the user is shown, and the fingerprint a sign-off will cite is computed from that file's contents rather than stored beside it.
alternatives: a structured file holding the text together with a stored fingerprint
why: The user reads the saved copy as written, and a fingerprint stored next to the text could disagree with it; computing it from the file means a sign-off always names exactly the words the user read (G5).

defines.definition: a short code computed from a file's exact contents, which changes if any character of the file changes
